When will I understand that you are the all-pervading mother? When will I be blessed with the vision of creation as your manifestation? O mother of the universe, please let me know...

Oh Sweet, Eternal Kali! O blissful Kali!

The vision of You purifies us of all sins; I prostrate to have that vision always.

AmbadiKanna.footer: Come quickly to the stage set in my heart, dancing to the musical notes. 2. Come running near to me, O son of Nanda, come running, O cowherd boy, who awakens the meaning of Omkara through the melody of the flute. Come O Kanna, who delights in playing the rasalila, O darling of Gokula, come playing, laughing, bathing, dancing and enjoying, in the flow of a nectarine stream of the music of my life.

Kindly shed light on the path that leads me to You. Hold my hands in Yours and bestow on me pure devotion to You.

AmbePahimam.footer: er, Who is all-auspicious. 1. When I enjoy Your motherly affection, there is an abundance of nectarous bliss in my heart. O Mother, Your caress, full of kindness, is like the cooling sandalwood paste. 3. To hear the chanting of Your Divine Name is sweet. Your Divine Mood is unforgettable. Then, the endless ocean of transmigration ceases to exist, and Your presence becomes clearly felt in my heart.

AmbikeDevi.footer: or serving Thee. Thy glory is beyond imagination. 4. O Mother, Thou art the sole Refuge and Support for everyone. O Durga, O Pure One who art most affectionate to Thy devotees, I bow before Thee. 6. Shower Thy mercy without delay on those devotees who incessantly fix their minds on Thee. 7. O Goddess, Thy very nature is Auspiciousness. Being the Truth, how can I adore Thee? My salutations to Thee.

AmbikeJagadisvari.title: Ambikê Jagadîåvarî
AmbikeJagadisvari.lyrics: Am bi kê ja ga dîåh wa rî pa ra mêåh wa rî ka ru ñâ ma yî ârt ta nâ dam i ton nu kêök ku va tin nu nî ka ni vê ru mô? En ti nî vi dham en ti nî vi dham en ti nî vi dham am bi kê nin de kun nyi ne niæhøhu ram ka da nat til iø øu va laykkyañam? An dha nâ o ru pin chu pai ta le an dha bhû vi ler in nu nî mâ ri nin nu ra si chi dun a tin en du nyâ yam i tam bi kê? On num on num a rin nyi dâ ta ti dî na nâ yo ru kun nyi ne krû ra jî vi ka öê ru mî va na bhû vil en di nu taö öi nî? At bhu tâ va ham â yi kam ta va sëæh øi lîl a na dap pa til en ne nî ba li yâk ki dunn o ru krû ramâm vi dhi yendi nô? Prê ma rû pi ñi al ve çhun a vaö en nu pê ru pu kaçhn na nî en ne yiø øu va la chi dun a tin en du kâ ra ñam îåh wa rî? Now I can only cry, "Ambike, Jagadiswari, Parameshwari, Karunamayi." Destitute that I am, I had to be born as Thy child. Please Mother, don't send us back to the world! 2. At Your doorstep lepers come, the poor and sorrowful ones come. You are all-knowing; can't You read my mind? Mother, what wrong did I commit? Keep me in Your thoughts forever. 3. Please accept all my accumulated sins at Your feet. Ignore me not, O Goddess of the World. Thou art the Goddess Lalita, Ruler of the World. O Mother, if Thou throwest me into troubles again and again, who else is there to protect me? O Mother with the enchanting eyes, Thou art the Omnipresent witness of all.

AmmaDeviTanitantana.footer: chorus 6x Chorus: O mother, Devi! A. O Kali Devi, I saw your dancing locks and the resplendent smile on your face, and was overwhelmed with love for you. 1. I know nothing about scriptures or their teachings; or sadhana or resolve. Wanting you alone I came away, O Durga Devi! 2. I am a little child. You are not a bad mother after all. Why do you delay in coming and taking me to you? O Chandi Devi!

You are the clear mind, and You are that ambrosia that we cannot get enough of. You are the one that exists and the one that doesn't exist. You are the essence of all truth. You are the essence of life, and You are a boon to the whole world.

AmmaHasattu.footer: and come, mother. O mother, come running to me! A: I have absolutely no one to depend on. Your lotus feet are my only refuge. 1. In this world of sorrow, I am suffering and crying. For my sake, O mother, come running to me, please come! 2. They say, ‘this is mine; this is mine’, but in the end, there is nothing I can call mine. I desire only for your protection, you are my only hope in this world.

AmmaKiChayaMe.footer: was wandering aimlessly. O Mother of the universe, I was longing in agony for one drop of love. 2. I was drowning in the illusionary ocean that constitutes this world. AmmeAmmeAmrtanandamayi.footer: sence, Your darling children offer You countless millions of prostrations. 1. When we wander along unlit paths, enshrouded in darkness, groping for the right path, Mother arises like the cool, full moon and the right path lights up before us. 2. When we, helpless children, cry in the fearful forest of sorrows, Mother comes and caresses us as the breeze of Compassion. And we forget all our sorrows.

AmmeAmrtanandamayiSarvagama.footer: e most loving Universal Mother. Salutations to You, the embodiment of Pranava (OM). 1. The nectar of compassion that flows from Your face is beyond comparison. At each step, my heart wishes only to dissolve into Your sweet words. 2. I do not know, my Mother, how my mind sought refuge as a slave at Your holy feet. Incessant nectar of compassion flows like the sea full of waves from Your holy abode.

AmmeBhagavati.lyrics: Ammê bha-ga va tî nit-ya kan yê dê-vî en-ne ka dâk æhi kum-bi-dun nên Mayê ja-gat tin te tâ yê chid â nan-da pri-yê ma hêåh wa-rî kum-bi dun nen Bâlê cha-tuëv vê da mûla mantrâk æha-rî mê-lê mê lê nin-ne kum-bi dun nen Ôm-kâ ra kûddi-le pa-in ki-öi pa i ta-lê nin kâ li ña yi-tâ kumbi dun nen Bhâëgga vi yâya-tum pâëvva-ti yâ ya-tum duëg-gâ bha ga va-ti nî tâ na lô Mûëtti-kaö mûva-rum dêva-tâ san gha-vum kât-yâ ya nî åhak-ti nî tâ na lô Châ yâ swa rû pi-ñi chaitan ya kâ ri-ñi mâ-yâ ma yê dê-vî kum-bi dun nen Lôkam chamak kya-yum rak shi chaçhik kyayum lô-kêåh wa rî nin-de lî la-yal lô Bâlê ma-nôn ma-ñi ponnammê nin nu-de lî layil nyâ nu ma ñuvu ta ne Tânon-num cheyyâ te saëv vam cheytî dun-na dî-na da yâ lô to çhun nên nin ne Brah-mâñ èa kôdi-ka öe sêvichî dun-na brah ma swa rû pi-ñi kum-bi-dun nên Lûtamka ñakke bhu vanam chamak kyunna mâ-tâ vê nin pâ-dam kum-bi dun nên Kâ-öî ka râ öî ma hiæh åhan ka-rî nâ lî ka lô cha-nê kum-bi-dun nên Kau-mâ rî sanka-èa nâåhi-ni bhâs ka-ri bhî-mât ma jê nin-ne kum-bi-dun nên Â-pat-tu nîkki tu ña chey ken am bi-kê nin pat tu sam bat-tu nal-ki dê ñam En-ne ka dâk-æhi kum-bi-dun nên

AmmeBhagavatiKalimate.lyrics: Am-mê bhaga-va tî kâ-öimâ tê nin-nenyân in nu pi di chu tin num On-ni va nô-tun nu am-ma nî kêö gañèañ-tâ muö öa piëa vi-yâ ñê Gañ-èân ta yô gam pi ëan-na piö öa taö öa-ye tin nun na piö öa yâ ñê On-nu-kil enne nî tin-ni-dê ñam al-lâi-kil in-nunyân nin ne tin num Rañ-di-lê ten ki lum on-na-ëin yê miñ øâ ti ni mê lil nyân a-dan gû Kaiy-yum mu kha-ru ma ten-nuvêñ èa mey-yi-lu mâ ke kari pu-rañ øen Kô-lum ka ya ëu mâi van-nu kâ lan châ lê ka ya ëiø øu chuø øi dum bôö Mê-lâ ke mel-le u çhinyu-dan nyân kâ-lan mukhat tu kari pu raø øum Kâ-öi-ye yuö öi lo tu ki-yôn nyân kâ-len de kai yil ku run gumennô Kâ-öitan nâ-mam ja pi-chu koñ è¨u kâ-lende nê re nyân gôæh øi kâø øum

How can I, who have contained Kali within me, be caught in the hand of Death? Chanting the Name of ’Kali’, I will mock at Kala (Death)!

AmmeKannuTura.footer: In this ignorant world, who else is there but Thee to remove the ignorance? Thou art the Essence of Knowledge and the Power behind this Universe. 2. Thou art dear to the devotees and art their very life blood. Won’t Thou graciously glance at us who always bow down to Thy Feet? 3. The Seven Sages are ever engaged in singing Thy praises and now we afflicted ones are calling to Thee. Won’t Thou come?

AmmeUlakam.footer: Love. 1. Please feed me daily with Thy own beautiful hand the nectar of love and thus remove my pride arising from the identification of the Self with the body and make me infatuated with that love. 2. O Mother, the Inner Core of the Scriptures, if my eyes should shed tears of devotion when I utter the Name of Kali, then all the Scriptures would become secondary things fit only for the intellect.

Please do not keep me waiting any more - draw me close to You and bestow inner tranquility to this tortured soul.

To the weary soul, Thou art the shade-giving Celestial Tree, aren’t Thou, O my Mother? 2. For the man drowning in the repeated cycle of birth and death, Thou art the refuge forever. May Thou always awaken in my mind Thy Divine Consciousness, O Devi.

O Mother Amritanandamayi, please let Your two Lotus Feet be the constant companions of this helpless one. 2. While this one wanders in the scorching noon-day sun of the Kali Yuga, O Mother Amritanandamayi, You are my shade. To my mind enveloped in darkness, You are the beacon of Light.

O Maheåvari, Destroyer of avarice, worshipping You with folded palms is the only recourse for the denizens of this world. Your lotus feet are the bestowers of all desires.

It is also the dharma that destroys the proliferation of desires, and it contains the essence of the Vedas. 4. The name 'Amriteswari' bestows the goal of human life, namely, liberation from transmigratory existence. It grants that which is eternal.

Daughter of the mountain, You who stride with the majesty of an elephant, O Mother.

O Parvati, the consort of Shambu, One who has the form of Shiva, who is of the form of the Vedas, whose Holy Feet are worshipped by the Devas, bestower of mental poise, who is worshipped by the entire world, who destroys Samsara, O Bhairavi, whose moods are Divine.

Protector of all who take refuge, Destroyer of the cycle of birth and death, Who pervades the Vedas and mantras. 4. O Lotus-eyed One! Whose form is like nectar to the eyes. With a soft and enchanting smile. Victory to You, Devi, salutaitons!

AmutamPoriyum.footer: ly shower the nectar of immortality in my heart. 1. You shine as OM. You offer shelter as the wish-fulfilling tree to those weary of the worldly life. I take refuge at Your lotus feet. 2. I’m drowning in this ocean of worldly existence. Please rescue me and ferry me across. Kindly liberate me, cutting asunder the chain of birth and death. May I ever be aware of Your effulgent Presence in my heart.

Anadhanakkarute.footer: ith destitutes and orphans is ever the abode of sorrow. 1. There are many sweet scented flowers in the garden of Your mind. O sovereign of my heart, are You aware of the grief of this withering flower? 2. How many years have vanished in vain like a dream in search of Your Lotus Feet for refuge? The compassionate Mother has not yet shown mercy. When is She going to lavish Her graceful glance on me?

You are the Mother of Ganesha and revered by the whole world. Exemplifying the Upanishadic truths, O Goddess of speech, You dispense boons upon us.

AnandaRupini.footer: iss, radiant with Self-effulgence? 1. O Mother! You are the moonlight which brightens the darkness of ignorance, why are You hesitating in dispelling the darkness of my mind with the illuminating rays of your radiant smile? 2. Through my notions of "I", "I", I am drowning in the depths of the ego. O Mother, You who are my very Self! Please be compassionate and merge me in Thee before this happens.

To remove the sorrows of humanity there are profound truths. "My darling child, leaving all other works; come to Me, you are always Mine." 9a. O Mother, why are You late today? Why did You give me this life? 9b. I do not know my mistakes. O Mother, please forgive me.

It is bliss to see Mother's beautiful form; her hair flows like the waves of the ocean. 4. It is bliss to see sandal paste on her forehead, representing Lord Shiva. When it is accompanied with kumkum (vermillion) representing Shakti, it is bliss!

AnandamayiBrahmamayi.footer: e, O Absolute One, Whose form is of unsurpassed beauty. O Blissful One, O Absolute One. 1. Crossing the six mystic centers, the yogis come to know Thee, the invaluable Treasure. However, Thy glory, O Infinite Power, is only slightly known to them. 2. Religions and castes have only helped to increase the arrogance of man. As the life of all humans and animals Thou restest at the bottom of the mind.

O Mother, come as the spring in the garden of love! Awake as a divine song in the veena of my life, in the flute of my vital breath. Awake as a flame of light in the path of yoga. Awake in my mind as the essence of wisdom, as equal vision.

AnandameAnandam.footer: puffed rice He has eaten is on my tongue. I inhale the sweet fragrance of His garland of wild flowers. With my lips, I blissfully sing about His leelas. My body slowly merges into His form. 3. My heart is becoming pure; now it is His temple! In my daily worship of Him, songs are the flowers I offer at His feet. My mind drinks the nectar of the Gita, and my ego falls at His feet. I am His servant.

I never dreamt that Thou wouldst drown me here in the dark waters of this shoreless sea. 4. Both day and night I swim amongst its waves, chaning Thy saving Name, yet even so O Mother, there is no end to my grief. 5. If I am drowned this time in such a plight, no one will ever chant Thy Name again.

Give me only sublime thoughts, O Lord Who art the Creator of this world, may I never feel any pride in my mind. 3. O Thou who exists in the seventh heaven, show me the way to sing Thy praises forever, to see Thee before me always and to meditate upon Thee in solitude.

O Lotus-eyed One, Dispeller of darkness, why is that Thou are not kind to me? Aren't my thoughts ever on Thy Lotus Feet? 2. O Kanna, put an end to this grief by bathing me in the moonlight of Thy smile and the nectar of Thy compassion.

My collection of merits is not big enough; my conduct is also poor. Please shower your grace for me to cross the ocean of suffering! 3. O Shiva! Please shower in me the radiant boon of total dedication. Please! May this blindness of transmigration be dispelled forever!

Mother of Earth, who caresses the bosoms of people with love, kindly accept this offering of my heart as the flower of worship.

Arikullil.footer: arted its lament. It is but the play of the Universal Architect, so why should you, O closing lotuses, be dejected? 1. This world, full of misery and sorrow, is but a drama of God and I, the onlooker, am but a wooden puppet in His hands having no tears to shed. 2. Like a flame, my mind is burning up in separation from Thee. In this ocean of grief I am getting tossed about unable to find the shore.

Aren’t You really like the celestial wish-fulfilling tree that gives shade within the heart, with Your never-ending kindness and readiness to come to my aid? O Mother, the whole world finds the radiance emanating in all directions from Your face, resembling the honey-filled flower at dawn, supremely exhilarating.

ArivenumAkakkan.footer: s in all as the formless Self? 1. Even as rays pour from the sun of wisdom, the dark clouds of delusion eclipse divine grace. But when the splendor of the divine mother manifests in my heart, all impediments vanish instantly. 2. An ignoramus am I, attempting to walk the path of inner awakening. The divine mother, unconditional in her love for all, will surely hold my hand and guide me to the goal.

When Thy Feet that give refuge shine in the blossom of my heart, won’t Thou innundate me with the moonlight of unknown Bliss, O Dark One?

O Mother, Who dwells in the heart, why art Thou delaying to give the bliss of the Self? 3

AsaNasiKatora.footer: arati to the Atman -- keep your attention focused on the Self. 1. Beware, if you keep up like this, in the end you will fall without any real support, and be full of remorse. If you cherish Eternal Bliss, if you covet Liberation, then meditate, O mind, meditate on your Source. 2. Meditate on the Ocean of Bliss within, give up your demoniac qualities, and follow the teachings of the Divine chants.

O Devi, please bless with me with immortal bliss. 2. The sorrows are infinite, the flowers are colorless, how much suffering must I endure? I will caress your feet with my tears and sorrows. O Devi, will you caress me with your compassionate glance?

My mind tells me that surely Sri Krishna must be hiding somewhere nearby. 3. If you will not return, O Lord, my tears will flow like the river Yamuna and the whole of Vrindavan will be submerged in the river of grief. Then, You will never again see your beloved Radha.

Even though knowing my faults, still Thou should grant me that unequalled peace without delay.

Am I not most dear to You, Krishna? Please do come back, O Murari. 2. I am melting, dwelling in Your thoughts. I have been crying continuously for You. Please do not delay any further, O Lord, please put an end to all my sorrows.

It is because of the tears we have shed awaiting Your darshan. 3.O, will someone make Him understand our pathetic condition. Please bring Him to us. At least kindle the remembrance of Vrindavan in His heart. Faster: Repeat 1st line of chorus as desired.

You are the mother of all things and You are the eternal truth. 4. This insignificant one surrenders his life as a flower offered at Your sacred feet. Draw me close and embrace me. Kindly make this birth of mine a blessed one.

Among all that is exalted, which is most exalted? It’s Krishna’s rasa-lila (mystic) dance. Among all that is exalted, which is most exalted? It’s the dance he enacted on Kaliya’s head. O Krishna, slayer of Madhu! O lord of speech, O supreme lord.

O Kalyani, please nurture good and auspicious qualities.

Don't be mournful, thinking that no one is with you. Don't give up, the Lord is at your side! Within this human life, what more is required? Leave all your sorrows behind and come running quickly! O Mind, come and worship Hari.

Your limbs, chest, forehead and torso are all beyond my range of perception; such is my agony that I know not where to apply the sandalwood paste.

BandaKrshna.footer: rus: Krishna has come and he spreads happiness and cheer. He enjoys the company of his devotees, the gopas. 1. Krishna, who carefully tends to the cows, has come with his divine instruments. 2. The one who removes our sins has come as Gopa. He removes our anger and our defects. 3. Krishna has come spreading divine and earthly pleasures. Vasudeva Vittala Himself has come. Faster: Chorus as desired.

She is approaching with a saffron mark on her forehead, wearing a golden girdle. 1. Mother Kali is approaching, wearing a garland of skulls, having annihilated demons Chanda and Munda. She is approaching, having made the whole universe her abode and the mind her shrine.

Chorus: O Krishna, who raised the Govardhana mountain, Krishna, who wears a garland of forest flowers, O my Lord, enemy of the demons! 2. The universe is Your family, every creature Your beloved. Please grant us that vision of oneness. 3. Work selflessly to remove people's suffering and teach us once again the ideals of karma yoga.

Bhagavane.footer: ho art the Lover of the devotees. 1. O Pure One, Destroyer of sin, there seem to be only sinners in this world. 2. Who is there to show the correct path? O Narayana, virtue has disappeared. 3. Mankind has lost all senses of truth and righteousness and real spiritual truths exist only in pages of books. 4. All that is seen wears the vesture of hypocrisy. O Krishna, protect and revive righteousness.

O descendant of Nanda, butter thief, who roams throughout Vrindavan, the Lord of the Yadus, son of a cowherd, You wander along the banks of the Yamuna river. 2. You destroy all sins and You destroyed the demon, Madhu. O compassionate one, eternal one, devoid of sorrows, liberated from samsara, You are our only refuge.

Without your blessings, we will not maintain liberation. 3. Your feet are our sole refuge. Your presence is our wealth. B. O goddess Bhavani, the embodiment of all the Vedas. O goddess Shivani, protector of the world of gods.

You who saved Draupadi’s chastity, come and bless Your devotees. Come, Kanna! Dear, dark-coloured One! 3. Oh lotus-eyed One! All that we behold is but Your form. We beckon You to come to us! We seek Your blessings for all time to come.

Blue-hued and beautiful, he is the remover of sins, the destroyer of the demon Mura. He is compassionate, and he will grant us ultimate Liberation. 2. Let us delight in worshipping Muchukunda, the lord with infinite attributes, the flawless one, Keshava, who holds that flute and is full of compassion.

My consciousness in the form of a bee peeped into the mind in order to enjoy the nectar of love of the One who wears a garland of wild flowers. 8. O Venugopala, Lord of my heart, Lover of devotees, Supreme Lord of all, grant me Thy Vision soon.

Your boundless love is a manifestation of the supreme truth. Knowing that, our seeking minds will merge into Your feet. 3. Your love is a ladder to the supreme consciousness. Climbing that ladder, we will attain Your lotus feet.

Know that as long as you entertain the thought of "I" and "you" as separate entities then you will never know peace. The same consciousness is in all beings, the inner essence in you pervades all others. 3. You are the master of the kingdom of the Self; you are never poor. Neither are you weak; you are the source of supreme power.

I have found a fragment of peacock feather - it came flying in wind and fell in my lap! Let us get up, my friend! This is a message that Krishna is coming. We are indeed blessed!

O Mother, Thou art the Creator of all these lilas – indeed, this entire Universe is your play. O Queen of the entire Universe, everything takes birth in You. You are the One that nourishes the world as well as the Cause that destroys it. Even Time is Thine Own Form, You reside in All, O Queen Mother.

O Mother, bless this child of yours to constantly enjoy the blissful nectar of your name.

DeviMukambike.footer: of art and of the poet. Thou art Devotion and Liberation; Thou art the very beat of my heart. 2. Thou art the quintessence of Vedanta. Thou have neither beginning nor end. All forms are Thee and formlessness too. Thou art the substratum of all minds. (Mookambika is a famous Devi temple of South India, by the side of the river Souparnika, in the state of Karnataka. The name means, "Silent Mother.")

DukhatiJvalayil.footer: o You. 1. My heart throbs with grief and my eyes have become feeble. How can I keep the boat of my life afloat at Your feet? 2. My heart yearns to become a drop in the ocean of Your love. Please rise up as the moon in the dark sky of my mind! 3. Kindly caress and cool my heart with the holy water of Your sweet words! Feed me the nectar of Your love and awaken in me a deep awareness of the Supreme.

GamGanapataye.footer: rld, who is worshipped by the intelligent, who is the Lord of the intellect, who is the bestower of Liberation, protector of Ganas. 2. O beautiful elephant-faced Lord, bestower of boons, who is the cause of real happiness, who is the very essence of the Vedas, who completely destroys the sorrows of those who seek refuge, whose form is Pranava (the Primordial Sound), Victory to You, O Lord Ganesha.

O quintessence of all knowledge! We worship You, that You may remove our bad karmas!

GanapatiGunanidhi.footer: n, O Lord Gunanidhi, bestower of boons, fill our lives with auspiciousness and remove our fears. 1. You, Lord, who speaks beautifully, are the river of compassion. Grace us with Your compassion and bring prosperity to our lives. 2. O Lord Ganapati, Son of Goddess Parvati, we worship Your lotus feet. We sing Your glories: please bless us that we may be freed from the bondage of worldly attachments.

GanesayaNamahOm.footer: ruga. 1. Oh Lord, You are an ocean of virtue and knowledge. Forever You burn radiantly in the hearts of the sages. You bestow true devotion and all well-being upon us. What can I do to please You? 2. Only one wish remains in my mind. I have only one desire. I long to see You. May the lotus of my heart bloom in Your light. May darkness be dispelled and may my mind dance in joy. Faster: to chorus 4x

O Leader of the Ganas, the bestower of the good, remover of all obstacles, bestower of knowledge and intelligence, O Lord Siddhivinayaka (another name of Lord Ganesha). 2. You are worshipped first by the devotees who sing Your glories, O Lord, remove all inauspiciousness from the world. Let peace and happiness prevail in the world.

Prostrations to Thee!

When the enchanting breeze from the Yamuna River touched me, my mind became an ocean of love. Will Kannan ever wander, looking for me also?

GiveUsGrace.title: Give Us Grace
GiveUsGrace.lyrics: Give us grace, give us love, Moth-er hear our prayer. Grant us strength for de-vo-tion in no-cent and pure. Free us to merge with You. Just a gaze will lift our soul. Please fill our wish to-day, have com-pas-sion Am ma Held in the grand il lu-sion, we are rest-less for truth. Will You light the lamp of knowl-edge, giv-ing in-ner peace? Caught in a sea of dreams, deep-er than a mind can hold. Your light brings high-er pur-pose, bless-ing sim-ple hearts. Bless us with Your grace. Bring us to Your peace. Teach us with Your song. Hold us in Your love.

O Krishna, the butter thief, the King of dance, O Lotus-eyed One, the Lord of Yadava's lineage who is served by all sages and saints. 3. O Krishna, who lives in Vraja, adorned wiht a garland of wild flowers, son of Vasudeva, Jayadeva is a great devotee of Yours. O Krishna, You are the Lord of the Universe and of all souls.

Krishna of Gokul, cowherd Krishna, protector of cows, beloved of Radha. You are existence, knowledge and bliss!

Thy endearing Name, O Giridhara, will fill the mind with auspiciousness. 2. O Madhava, Thy different moods will transform the sorrows of the heart into nectar. Krishna has a smiling face, he is the Lord that steals our hearts.

Mother Amrite•vari, Goddess of the Universe, Bestower of desired boons, Who holds the wine of Love, O merciful one. As eye-lids protect the eyes, kindly protect us and shower on us all good fortune.

O Krishna...Treasure of Compassion...I salute Thee with joined palms...I humbly salute Thee...

Please find a brief moment to help me surrender all at Your Feet.

The beautiful smile of Amma became the flower garden of the Universe. 2. In the beginning, You had a dream. In that dream, we are all waves. How can we tell your story? 3. How can I defame or praise something, everything being Your divine play? How can I talk about You?

IswarTumhiDayakaro.footer: Other than You, who is here to look after us? 1. You are the creator and the destroyer of the world. Even misfortune is Your creation. Other than You, who is here for us? 2. You are our Mother, Father, Benefactor and Friend. You are our only refuge. Other than You, who is here for us? 3. We don't know anything. Without our love for You, what would become of us? Other than You, who is here for us?

Won't you deign to save your children who are in the throes of suffering? Henceforth, we will follow the wisdom of our ancestors. Lord of obstacles, with a huge body and a crooked trunk, formed like the Sacred OM, grant me victory. 2. Golden hued, worshipped by the gods, with a mouse (of desires) as a vehicle. You are the master of all Gods, O great Goddess, the wife of Siva and the bestower of fearlessness. Auspiciously married one, having a beautiful smile, O eternal virgin, You bear all fame, luminous one, You sustain all the worlds. To chorus (2x), A(2x), Verse 1 (2x), B(2x), chorus (4x), coda.

JayKalyaniJayBhavani.footer: tory to Goddess Bhavani. Victory to Divine Mother Durga. 1. Mother, embodiment of compassion. Listen to the prayer of Your servant and liberate us from this samsara (cycle of births and deaths). Please fulfill the purpose of this human birth. 2. Please remove all worries and sorrows. Fill my heart with devotion towards You. I offer myself in worship at Your feet. Mother, this life is only for You.

JayMataDi.footer: the earth, Rajarajesvari - The queen who rules over all the rulers. 1. Mother Kali dwells in the cremation grounds; Mother Durga is seated on the lion. You who put an end to the life of the demon Mahisha, please save me, O my dear Mother. 2. Goddess Minakshi of Madurai is a young girl; Goddess Kamakshi of Kanchipuram is Mother Karumari. I am singing Your glories; please save me, O my dear Mother.

JhilamJhilam.footer: . Kalika smiled at me; it was like the full moon flooding me with its cool refreshing light. Ambika filled my mind with clarity, with ineffable peace. 5. O Mother, I will never forget You and commit mistakes again. My only refuge from now on will be my love and devotion for You. I will always remember You, even at the time of my death. The only rest I will ever know will be when I am at Your feet.

Let us all chant together - victory to the Mother, victory to the Mother.

Jivitamennum.footer: are unblemished, who are filled with the fragrance of yoga. 3. You are the abode of compassion for one and all, the treasurehouse of knowledge, arts and poetry. You are full of the sweet nectar of love and compassion and You are to be meditated upon. 4. O Mother, You are the new melody emanating from the sonorous veena of human life. You are the primal sound that rains down as the nectar of love.

Jnanakkataltannai.footer: olution? 1. As I wander in search of You, unwanted thoughts may come and distract me, pulling me in another direction. O, She who attracts the masses! Come and stay with me like a protective shadow. 2. When I bow in reverence, remaining as one with the Soul, You glance at me with love and compassion. To check the intensity of my search, You test me in different ways, and then grant me pure bhakti.

Jnanayoga.footer: ). I have no love for Bhakti Yoga (the yoga of devotion) - all I can do is hold onto your feet! 1. My memory is poor, I have no talent for music, I have had little schooling - my only refuge is your two feet! 2. I am a child who does not know the reasons for your tests. Mother! Please console this child's sorrow, this child who cries when he gazes upon you! 3. Grant me refuge at your feet, Mother!

JvalanaKalyana.footer: y. 2. You remain forever my only truth. The inner bliss beyond the intellect is Your real essence. We can never be separate, as You reside in me as my own true Self. You are the indestructible principles of the scriptures. 3. My heart aches for Your grace, it is ablaze to reveal its yearning to You, Mother. In the unrelenting remembrance of Your holy feet, may the full-moon of eternal bliss arise.

KabAyeGa.footer: nal love? 1. O Lord, when will I be overcome with love while listening to Your words? When will I perform the diving dance in the Vrindavan of my mind? 2. When will I be free from the strong hold of the ego? It will come to be when, in our hands, I become Your flute. 3. Drinking the nectar of love, when will I become love itself? When will I become one with You, as the river merges into the ocean?

May you become the boat that carries us across the ocean of transmigration. May you become the ladder to uplift the downtrodden. May you remove the dizziness of our forgetfulness. May thoughts of you grow in my heart. Faster: To chorus as desired.

KadiranuEnagende.footer: grace makes my heart blossom into a flower? 1. The river of life has many obstacles, many contradictions, many paradoxes. I am struggling, turning around and around, to avoid getting caught in the whirlpool. 2. Mother, please be compassionate towards those who have come seeking refuge! Please glance at me, in my pitiful state. Please make my heart blossom like a flower, and shine your grace on me.

O Thou with lotus-like eyes, why are Thou so late in coming? 2. O Thou of enchanting form, my infatuation is growing to enjoy Thy bright songs. Let all my accumulated burdens, that are swelling within, merge in Thy beautiful tune.

The worthless piece of bamboo (the flute) is a source of unequalled joy. The Boy from the Yadu dynasty has given such a high status even to a peacock feather. You are the greatest sage among all sages, o enchanting rasa-dancer.

Experiences last for a moment; we are only witnesses to our experiences. 3. Sorrow ends when we break the bondage of birth and death that is created through desires. Embrace the path of the contemplation of the Self and enjoy supreme bliss.

Today I still sob with the pain of separation from Mother. 3. Come and dwell in me forever, as eternal springtime, as immaculate divine love. Then I will taste that ocean of nectar of your pure love. Let me climb to that divine abode.

Saraswati, Goddess of knowledge, You love music and play upon the veena. 3. Mother Gauri, Your form is Maya and this entire creation is Your sport. Faster: Repeat song. End with chorus 4x.

Kî rip pi öa run nu nen cha kam pot tun nu nî rip pu ka yun nu pra ñan ga öum sa khî! En nât ma nâ than ma nô ha ran mâ dhavan en na ri kat tin nu met tât ta ten dê? Râ vê re chen nu vô pâ ti râ vâ ya tô? â åhyâ ma chan dran u di chu vô mal sa khî? Paurñ ña mi râ vin n a mâ vâ si yâ yi tô? ta sa mî ra ñan tît ti ra yâ yi tô? Is it my fate that the Glorious One, who has become a sorrowful cloud which rains down heavily, has turned into the Dark One?

KallumAvane.footer: n Tamil Nadu) Even though the gods are many, true grace is Shiva. In all these forms, the formless one is Shiva. One who worships Shiva becomes Shiva. One who worships Vishnu becomes Vishnu. Even if it is Lord Muruga, his son, Shiva is the ultimate truth. Whatever name one worships, Shiva will come in that form. Whatever truth one worships, Shiva will come in that truth. I prostrate to lord Shiva.

You are the blissful absorption arising from constant meditation. You are the nectar of the heart ecstatic with devotion. You are the constant refuge to those who have no other support, You are the wealth of experience of the heart absorbed in divine bliss.

O Krishna, Treasure of Compassion, why are You delaying to enter the temple of my mind?

O Kanna, won't You say anything to me? O Kanna, my heart is aching to see Thee. Haven't You noticed me yet? 2. O Omnipresent One, are You not here? Am I not a child who knows nothing? Will You come here to rid me of the sorrow that fills my mind?

KannendeKalocha.footer: (Krishna’s) footsteps were heard on a silvery moonlit night. 1. Hearing the notes of the flute, my mind merged in a golden dream. 2. Manifesting this pure, bright moonlight, oh fragrance of the winter season, seeing that honey-laden smile, my mind is shining blissfully, O Kanna. 3. I have innumerable stories to tell. Kanna, please don’t go! In the blissful lake of my mind, please stay for a bath.

Kannilengilum.footer: orus: Thou not with these eyes, today I have seen my darling Krishna, the Beloved of Radha, with the Inner Eye! 1. I have seen the Stealer of the mind, Beauty Personified, the Divine Musician. I have seen my Lord of Oneness. 2. Was He the blue colour of the ocean? Did He have a peacock feather adorning His curly locks? I can’t say, but through the sound of the Flute, I have seen His gracious Form.

Kannimaykate.footer: . Radha quickly rose up in her eagerness. 4. As she stared into the distance her breathing became constricted and Her eyes, resembling peacock feathers, became still. Her soft body became stiff. 5. As she heard the soft sound of foot bangles she danced in bliss like a flower moving in a breeze. 6. She heard a sound, "oh Radha, come closer, " which flowed as if from the source of a river of nectar.

You walked away slowly, as if You were forgetting something. Was it my life breath that You forgot, or the bamboo flute? I stood there, frozen in thought. 3. I heard that since that day, Kanna has not played His flute, but I still hear that flow of music in my mind.

I surrender all my desires at your feet, made sublime. 3. O enchanting one, awaken within me and remove the darkness in my heart. Devotion and liberation are but the blessing of your grace; a glance from your eyes bestows inner purity.

Though Thou delayest in giving what I want, my mind sits satisfied because of Thy Maya. 3. Will Thou allow me to offer a red flower at Thy Feet? 4. Through this forlorn path I wander in the hope of finding Thee. 5. Is there any kindness in Thy hard heart, tell me, O Beloved of Åiva?

When will Thou come to save this sobbing, weeping maid who is drowning in her tears? 3. Bless me to be reborn as grass or a grain of sand on Thy path. Otherwise, make me, O Madhava Krishna, a speck of the sandalwood paste to be smeared by the servants of Thy devotees.

When He will come is not known, but without blinking, you should watch and wait for Him. 3. When the cloud-colored Kannan comes, please don’t tell anything about me. O eyes, you just lead him to the inner eyes and then let me be awakened.

Karumaiyile.footer: be Your greatness. O Mother Kali, divine Mother Durga! 1. I came to the sanctum, and Your beauty melted my heart. Leaving past and future behind, I have the fortune to live in the present. O Mother Kali, divine Mother Durga. 2. Seeing the dual aspect, I will become Your slave. In the advaita aspect (oneness), like the wave and the sea, will You and I become one? O Mother Kali, divine Mother Durga.

Is He not our friend who used to pour out nectarous music through His flute? It is unlikely that He is hard-hearted. 3. Oh, Embodiment of Compassion, know that Radha lives only for Your vision. Glance at me once, give me one smile. For that I can do tapas for ten million births.

Karunasagara.lyrics: Ka ru ñâ sâ ga râ åhrî râ mâ pâ va na nâ ma pa ram dhâ ma Åhrî râ mâ en kaö râ jâ râ mâ Mo ha na râ mâ ra ghu râ mâ Uö öam u ru ki u ñarvin u ñarvai uö öat til u ña ra vaip pâ yo Veö öam pôn dra u na tan pil vêñ èi u rai ya vaip pâ yo Kâ ñum kâd chi kâ nal nîr e na ka rut ti nil u ña ra vaip pâ yo Ni rai ma ti yâ y en uö öam a til o öi yin u ru vâ y o öir vâ yo Râ mâ åhrî râ mâ Râ mâ pa ram dhâ mâ Râ mâ ra ghu râ mâ Râ mâ ja ya râ mâ Râ mâ jay jay râ mâ

Karunasagara.footer: iful Rama of the Raghu clan! 1. Will you make me realize, my heart melting, that you are closer than the closest? Your love equals pure sweetness. Make me understand the sweetness of your love. 2. Everything I see is a mirage… won't you make me realize that? Won't you shine inside my heart like the full moon? B&C: O Lord Rama, Supreme Abode! Victory to you, O Rama! Repeat B(4x,4x,4x), C as desired

KarunatanKatamiri.footer: hou art the Ruler of the Earth, Destroyer of sorrow and giver of good. Therefore, show mercy on me. 2. Mother, give me a chance to adore Thy flower-like Feet. May Thy look of compassion fall on me that I may become filled with bliss. 3. Kindly shower the nectar-like drops of Thy Pure Love on my miserable and helpless mind. By doing so, I can bathe and swim in the cool waters of the Ocean of Bliss.

KarunyaMurte.lyrics: Kâ ruñ ya mûët-tê kâ yâmbû vaëñ ñâ kañ ñu tu ëan ni da ñê duï kha ni vâ ra-ka nal lô nî yen tâ pa ma kat tî da ñê tâ pa ma kat tî da ñê U la kil âåh ra-yam nî yê chen tâ ma ra kañ-ñâ ma ñi vaëñ ñâ ñâ Pû ja kya-nu di-nam puæh pan gaö en de Kañ ñu nîr â ñu këæh ñâ kañ ñu nîr â ñu këæh ñâ I ru öil u çha lu ka yâi nyân mâ na sa mô ha-na gô pâ lâ Î rê çhu la ki lum ni ëan nya åhrî dha-ra Kañ ñu tu ëan ni da ñê tâ pa ma kat tî da ñê Tâ pa ma kat tî da ñê

KarunyaMurte.footer: . Art Thou not the Destroyer of sorrow? This being so, do remove my sufferings. 1. In this world Thou art the shelter, O bright-coloured One with eyes like the petals of a red lotus. I worship Thee forever with the flowers of my tears, O Krishna. 2. O Gopala, enchanter of the mind, I am groping in the darkness. O Thou Who fillest the fourteen worlds, O Sridhara, open Thy eyes and rid me of sorrow.

O embodiment of bliss, substratum of this changing universe, I salute Thee. 2. Neither is it necessary to immerse oneself in the holy waters nor undergo severe austerities; to make one's life blessed, keep the mind firmly centered upon Mother!

KarunyaVaridhe.title: Kâruñya Vâridhê
KarunyaVaridhe.lyrics: Kâ ruñ ya vâ ri-dhê këæh-ñâ nit ya mê ëun nu jî vi ta këæhña Il lâ ma nas si-nu åhânti ai yô vallâ te yâ yi vi bhrânti Tet tu-kaö el lâm po ëut tu van-nen net-ti vi yaëp pu tu dakkyû Kañ-ñâ mat-til li ni ya va lambam nin de pa da ma laë chêvaèi yennum Kañ-ñâ Toñ-da va ra öun nu këæh-ñâ kañ ñu rañ-dum pa ta ëun nu këæh-ñâ Pâ dan gaö rañ dum ta öaën nu mañ-ñil vî ñu pô kun nu åhrî këæh ñâ Kâ ruñ ya vâ ri-dhê këæh-ñâ nit ya mê ëun nu jîvi-ta këæh-ñâ Nit ya mêëun nu jîvi-ta këæh-ñâ Nit ya

KarunyaVaridhe.footer: 1 2 Chorus: O Krishna, Ocean of Compassion, the thirst for life is ever increasing. A: There is no peace for the mind and alas, confusion is so much. 1. Forgiving all wrongs, wipe off the sweat from my brow. O Kanna, now I have no support other than Thy worshipful Lotus Feet. 2. O Krishna, the throat is drying up, the eyes are failing, the feet are tired and I am falling to the ground, O Krishna.

Karvarnnane.title: Kârvarññanê
Karvarnnane.lyrics: Kâr varñ ña nê ka-ru ñâ ma-ya nê kañdô kâ yâm bûkkaöê nin gaö? Karvarnnane.footer: in my memory. Who is it, that imparted the music to the playful breeze which arouses the Om sound? 2. My eyes are tired of searching for Him everywhere, in all places where the kadamba flowers bloom, in all places where the blue lotuses bloom. 3. Closing my eyes and thinking of Krishna, I cried in anguish which filled my soul. Alas, I could not find him even now. Why has Kanna given me tears only?

KasturiTilakam.footer: ars the Kaustubha gem on His chest. Verse: From Krishna’s nostril hangs a pearl ring and in His hand is a flute with bracelets around His wrists. Sandalwood paste is applied to all His limbs and there is a pearl necklace around His neck. Victory to that Krishna Who is surrounded by the cowherd women and is the Crest Jewel of the cowherds! Book I, p 197 AMR(I)-39, WTR 1991/1, Old is Gold 2 Sanskrit

KatinnuKatayi.lyrics: Kâ tin nu kâ-tâi ma nas sin ma nas-sâi kañ-ñin nu kañ ñâi vi-la-sun no ram mê Prâ ñan nu prâ ñan nî tan ne yal lô jî van nu jî van nin nuñ ma yal lô Ât mâ vi nât mâ va la kaö ko râ çhi vi dyâ më tat tin a më-tâ yor am mê A më tât ma mut tê â nan da sattê åhrî ma-hâ mâ yê brah ma vum nî yê Kañ ñan gu pô kâ ma na vum cha lik kyâ vâk kan gu mû-kam nin mun nil am mê Kañ èen nu kañ dôn kañ dil la nin ne bud-dhik-kyum mê lê mê vum ma hê åhi Sur yan jwa lik kyâ swa-yam chan dra tâ ram am mê nin tê-jas sil el lâm jwa lik kyum Dî ran o râ öî vi vê kât ma bô dhâl pa-ram tat wa viåh-rân ti mâëg gam ga mik kyum

Those who say they have seen Thee have not really done so, as Thou, O Great Goddess, art beyond the intellect. 3. The sun, moon and stars shine not of themselves but are illumined by Thy Brilliance. Through discrimination the courageous one alone can tread on the path to the Abode of Eternal Peace, the Supreme Truth.

KattitukammeIKomala.footer: Masters, but these children have none other than Amma as refuge in this world. 2. Our very breath, the vital force, everything was dissolved in Amma a long time ago. These children can't live further in a world bereft of You. 3. There is no place for any other thoughts in us. We don't even long for liberation. What we want is this embodiment of love. Therefore, please preserve your beautiful body.

KattrakaNan.lyrics: Kât trâ ka nân i run dâl en na se y vên am mâ nî pô kum i øa mel lâm nâ num va ru vên Ni la mâ ka nân i run dâl en na se y vên am mâ un pâ dam tâm gik koñ èu pû rit ti rup pên Ne rup pâ ka nân i run dâl en na se y vên am mâ un kô yil dî pa mâ ka su øar vi øu vên vên Vi sum pâ ka nân i run dâl en na se y vên u nak ku vâ na vil lâl tô ra ñam kaø øi ma kiçh vên Nî râ ka nân i run dâl en na se y vên un dan pâ dâ bhi æhê kam sey yum pan nîr â vên vên Pû vâ ka nân i run dâl en na se y vên am mâ mâ lai yâ ki un tô öil sâ yn du koö vên Ku yi lâ ka nân i run dâl en na se y vên am mâ un nô øu bhak ti gâ nam pâ øi ma kiçh vên vên

KattrakaNan.footer: emple. 2. If I were the ether, what would I do? O Mother, I would delight in festooning the skies with a rainbow. If I were water, what would I do? O Mother, I would be the rose-water that washes your feet. 3. If I were a flower, what would I do? O Mother, I would rest on your shoulders as a garland. If I were a cuckoo, what would I do? O Mother, I would revel in singing devotional songs with you.

Thy stream of Love flows toward me in the form of anger and Thy terrific laughter is like a pleasing smile to me. Understanding the unreal nature of the dream-like world, I took leave of it. But I will never get separated from Thee who has showered ambrosial grace upon me.

My mind becomes a blossoming flower to be offered for worship as it falls at Your tender feet of incomparable beauty, O Kanna. O Indweller of my heart, Murari (Krishna), let me ascend the peacock of my mind and revel in You.

O Mother, I will wash Thy flower-like Feet with my hot tears. 3. O Mother, I am getting tired of this unbearable burden of the fruits of past deeds. O Mother, be not late to give refuge to this humble servant of Thine who is getting utterly exhausted.

Even if I forget You, Mother, I know that You will never forget me. If I forget You in my happiness, You will still be beside me in my sorrow. 3. Accept this request of mine and make my mind Your abode. Whenever I do something wrong, Mother, point it out to me then and there.

KhushiyomKiBahar.footer: peace. Oh Lord, may we become selfless and free of desires and thus may we progress steadily towards You. 2. Let all people in the world be content. Let them see the divine spark in all others and let the light of love shine in their hearts. May all live in harmony. Ending: Let us pray and hope together. We will chant constantly the divine mantra that is a prayer for the entire world to be happy.

Inaccessible to all, Thy infinitesimal Flame, glowing like the effulgence of the sun, stands still without dancing even in the fiercely blowing cyclone. 3. Flowers, creepers, shrine rooms and temples with newly installed sacred pillars, all are waiting for Thee since aeons and aeons, but still Thou art inaccessibly distant.

KrpaKaro.footer: our grace upon me that this mind does not wander aimlessly. May it always chant the mantra of renunciation. May it always speak the language of love. 1. When life becomes full of happiness, may I not forget You. When sadness comes, may I never lose faith in You. 2. When I am about to depart from this earth, may I find You near me. May my lips utter Your divine name. May my mind revel in You alone.

O merciful Mother with a beautiful smiling countenance, Uma, come out of Your hiding place. Don’t delay any more. 5. Hail to Devi, Parvati, Jagadambika, Sankari, Paramesvari, Siva Sakti, Lalitambika, Jagadisvari, Amritesvari, Kalike. My humble prostration to You, O Mother, Goddess of my heart.

KuchNaLe.footer: Hari. Only He will accompany us. Chorus: Chant the name of Hari. 1. You do not know what tomorrow will bring. This life itself is merely a journey of a few days. B: Do not waste any more time. Start chanting the name of Hari. 2. In good times, there will be many well wishers in your life. But when bad times come there will be nobody to offer you any support. Nobody loves another more than oneself.

Thy kind glance must fall on me. O Son of Åiva, show Thy mercy. 2. O Primal Lord Who has crossed the river of Becoming, Abode of mercy, Giver of auspiciousness, O Hari, Nectar of Bliss, Destroyer of misery, show Thy compassion.

KuriyaniKanniru.footer: ed tears become the perfumed water gaining refuge at Your lotus feet. 1. Imminent troubles blissfully change into the garlands of flowers at Your feet. Unspoken words resonate like Om, and establish Your soft feet in my heart. 2. The unmelting ego becomes the camphor arati to worship Your divine form in my heart. In the depths of the pit of my unripened life, You bring the light of a million suns.

O cowherd boy, lord of the gopis. O consort of Radha, her joy and delight.

Chorus: Salutations to the Divine Mother, the bestower of auspiciousness, the bestower of eternal refuge. 2. When a little crying child calls for his Mother, the Mother, leaving everything, comes running towards him. O Mother, You are the Mother of the whole universe. Why delay in granting your vision?

You are the atman! 2. You are not the body, but the atman! You are not bound; you are the atman! Renounce the ego and know yourself to be the witness. You are the embodiment of bliss and the heir to immortality. You are the atman!

Mil-lions of forms are born out of u ni ty, chang ing yet ev er the same. of the u ni watch-es in rap ture the sto ry of truth ev er last ing, the sto ry of truth ev er last ing. Long, long a go in a heav en ly dream, truth was a vast gold en sea. We were the waves, al-ways ris ing and fall ing, one with the mys ti cal o cean, one with the mys ti-cal o cean. What is the pur pose of prais-ing or blam-ing, tak ing the play to be real? When do the stars ev-er ques tion the sky? Oh Moth-er, the world is Your gar den, oh Moth-er, the world is Your gar den. Moth er Your play is e ter nal.

LifeIsAPlay(Pray&Serve).title: Life is a Play
LifeIsAPlay(Pray&Serve).lyrics: Life is play so en chant ing. this world is di vine ly cre at ed. No end, no be gin ning to this deep mys tery, Moth er Your play is e ter nal. Mil-lions of forms are born out of u ni ty, cre a ting the u ni we see. Am ma Your smile be comes our cre a tion, a blos som ing gar den e ter nal. Long, long a go in a heaven ly dream, Your play was a vast gold en sea. We were the waves, al ways ris ing and fall ing, how can we tell our sto ry? What is the pur pose of prais ing and blam ing, tak ing the play to be real? We are but ac tors in Your di-vine play. How can we sing Your glo ry? Moth er Your play is e ter nal.

My mind goes to Amma's feet to swim in the waves of bliss

MalarumManavum.footer: will never forget Thee. 1. Thou hast added so many beautiful chapters to this life book of mine. O Embodiment of Compassion, never let there come a time when I am separated from Thy Feet. Allow not my memory to forsake Thee. 2. There is no space to separate us for Thou abidest within me only. In all births to come, make me the worshipper of Thy Lotus Feet. That would be the fulfillment of my life.

I offer these to You, who are the very embodiment of nectarean kindness, and who are enraptured in music that is permeated by the sound OM. 2. O You of beauteous form, Bestower of auspiciousness, who delights in making the gift of mental peace, and are the presiding deity in the hearts of Her devotees, please abide in my mind.

Why do you cry now that you are enslaved? It is you who created your own enslavement. Until you stop planting the seeds of future problems with your current selfish actions, how will you attain to the untimate state of freedom, O mind?

The early part of life is spent in helpless cries and youth is spent in lustful attachment. 4. Now old age is coming and all of your strength will be taken away. You are going to become like a helpless worm and without any work, will spend the time looking forward to the grave.

Change my fate to goodness. 2. You change the aspect of whatever obstacle comes to me. Without You there is no refuge. You are the mountain of compassion. 3. I take refuge in Hara, Shankara, Shiva, Shambho (all names of Lord Shiva)!

I don't seek wealth or any of the sense pleasures. If the baby longs to see its Mother, is that a crime?

Our whole life has remained meaningless. We have become blown up with pride. We never remember the name of the lord. At least now, awaken, O mind of mine! Immerse yourself in the lotus feet of the guru, meditate on the words of the guru.

ManasaMalaril.lyrics: Mâ na sa ma la-ril ma ñi varñ ñan ent tun na su di nat tin â yi ram a bhi vâ da nam hë da yat til a na vad ya su kha dâ nam cho ri yun na su di nat tin â yi ram a bhi vâ da nam. ManasaMalaril.footer: n abundance of happiness. 1. I wish to flow through the Yamuna river of sweet melodious music, coming through the bamboo flute played by the tender lips of Krishna. Let my heart overflow with that sweet nectar of the kamboji raga. 2. Chanting the holy name of Krishna, shedding tears, intoxicated with divine love and having the vision of the Lord, I will merge into that all-pervasive Consciousness.

I am tired Mother; it is unbearable. I don’t want such a life. I can’t stand Your tests. O Mother, I can’t endure it! 4. I am a miserable destitute. I have none but You, Mother. Please stop Your tests, extend Your hand and pull me up.

If i say, “I, I,” correct me into saying, “your feet.” If I say “I did it”, correct me into saying “it’s your prasad.”

ManaseKelu.footer: A: Time is passing by, but the path remains to be covered. Walk fast, walk forward. 1. Do not waste time in attachment and aversion. Do not squander days in likes and dislikes. Do not let yourself trip before the obstacle of maya. With the strength of the remembrance of the name of god, keep on going forward. 2. There is mother. She is calling you. Isn’t mother’s lap our real home? Mind, O mind...

ManaseNinSvantamayi.footer: ss, God, Whose nature is Truth, resides in all beings. 9. Position, prestige and wealth are all impermanent; the only Reality is the Universal Mother. 10. In order to gain devotion, even the ancient sages did penance with a pure heart. 11. The Lord will attract devotion-soaked souls like a magnet attracts iron. 12. Renouncing all desires, let us dance in that bliss singing the Name of Mother Kali!

In the beauty of that flower, I saw Your enchanting face. 1. When I saw Your everlasting beauty, devotion welled up inside of me, and I began to cry. 2. After so much desperate searching, all the great sages came to know You through the inner Self.

ManavaHrdayattil.footer: ease let me focus my mind entirely on You, and remain immersed in that meditation. 1. You are the essence of the peace of Nirvana, reposing in the human heart like sweet nectar. You illumine the path of human destiny. 2. Those who salute You and those who insult You are the same to You -- they are all Your dear children. You shower the nectar of Love equally on all, and abide as the Mother of all.

ManavuNondiralu.footer: n your companionship. 1. On the dark path, You shed light. Is it not your love my support for life? When you are holding my finger, I have no fear. It is not Your Grace that protects me, O Amma? 2. You the Mother of the World, have you forgotten me? Is it not your lap which is my refuge? When I was about to fall, your Love became bridge. Is it not your compassion that will help me cross the Ocean?

Devotees wait for AmmaÕs arrival like the chatak bird waits for rain. Amma is the Ocean of Mercy. Amma will never forget anyone. 3. Hearing the sweet tune of the flute I have come here. Can one ever resist the Divine Nectar of KrishnaÕs Love?

A. O the One with the Moon, O the One with the trident, I seek refuge of Mallikarjuna (Shiva). 2. Let my body live for you. Let me have strength to do your work. Let me live for you. Let me have my last breath in your service.

The moon has faded away and the flame of the lamp only casts a shadow of scorn. The stars, as if coming down, have started uttering: 2. "O man, the human birth is in your hands. Why do you wish it to be lost? Through your actions, love of God and knowledge of Truth, become one with That."

MuraliDharaSundara.footer: The Goddess Lakshmi massages Your tender feet. When walking, You appear like a mighty elephant. You are the dearest companion of the Gopis who reside in Vrindavan. In battle, You have destroyed all demons. 3. You are the eternal refuge of those who seek protection from You, carrying us all across the vast ocean of transmigration. Oh cowherd boy, You compassionately shower boons upon Your devotees.

MuraliNinadam.footer: loud, to extinguish the fires of sorrow of the heart, O lotus-eyed Krishna, will You come? 1. In order to relieve the pains of my heart, by seeing Your beautiful steps, smile and eyes full of compassion, O lotus-eyed Krishna, will You come? 2. The melodious music emanating from Your flute will create waves of sweet bliss which will flow continuously to my heart-lake, filling it and overflowing it.

Muraliganamutirkkunnu.footer: heard everywhere, bringing joy to all. 1. The water, earth, wind and all of creation on earth are in ectasy listening to the Lord's music. 2. All of the gopis and gopas of Vrindavan gather round Krishna and join in the rasa lila dance. 3. O Krishna! Please come and dance in my heart so that I too will become blissful. With Your compassion, please make my life meaningful by granting me immortality.

Hearing the flute, Narada dances and everyone sings "Hari, Hari!" 2. Hearing the flute, everyone came running to the forest. Even the restless waves of the Yamuna came running to the banks. The Gopis, who were anxious for Krishna's darshan, attained great bliss.

Disguised as an old man you took the hand of the gypsy girl Valli in marriage. You revealed the meaning of the pranava mantra 'om' to your father and stood tall among Satgurus. O auspicious Lord Muruga, please protect this child!

In this impermanent world, we suffer without any protection. Please come immediately and bless us. 3. We come to Your Lotus Feet knowing that You are our sole refuge. Please give us the eternal state which is the fruit of the human birth.

Thou, who art the cool breeze that pacifies the heat of the illusory world, manifest as my unfading, fragrant love and flow thorugh me. Come soon O Light of my life! Disappearing the darkness of the notion of "I", take me to Thy Lotus Feet.

NaiyyaTere.title: Naiyyâ Têrê
NaiyyaTere.lyrics: Naiy yâ tê rê jî va n kî gu m râh kai sê hô ga yi Su kh ki or nik li thi du kh sâ ga r mê khô ga yi Ta n dha n pa r hî dhyân di yâ a p nê sa t kô bi s râ di yâ yâ Pa râ yê kô tû a p nâ sa m jhâ jhâ A p nê kô øu krâ di yâ Pa yâ A han kâ r kê jâ l mê tû ban di ba n ka r ra h ga yâ A p nê an da r kê hî rê kô kô Pa h châ nê bi nâ tû ra h ga yâ Na sô ch di n hê ba hut jâ nê ka bh naiy yâ dû b jâ yê Kâ l jô â yê dwâr tê rê rê Ka l ta k tû na hi øâl pâ yê Du kh sâ ga r mê khô ga yi

NaiyyaTere.footer: cean of sorrow. 1. You paid attention to wealth and body alone, forgetting your true self. You thought a stranger to be yours, forsaking your own self. 2. In the trap of the ego, you became a prisoner, unable to recognize the jewel inside you. 3. Don't think there are endless days; who knows when the boat may sink? If tomorrow comes to your door, you will not be able to put it off to the next day.

What actually is relationship and who is related? All your enchanting heavenly beauties will be wiped away! Here awaits our own Mother. O little baby, you can sleep in the lap of the Eternal Mother while hearing the lullaby.

NamJapo.footer: than to Rama himself! 1. By chanting the lord’s name, one’s bad karma comes to an end and the mind merges in the divine. No one can express the glory of chanting that name. Whoever chants it reaches truth! 2. Rama gave liberation only to a few in his lifetime, but his name has granted deliverance to millions. The moon and stars are witness to this - therefore, chant the name, be it Rama or Murari!

I pray to YOu, O Daughter of the Mountain (Himalaya), I prostrate before You constantly. 3. Victory to You, O auspicious One. O eternal, all-pervading Auspiciousness. Victory to You, O Kali. I prostrate before You constantly.

Nammavararu.footer: one we call 'our' is our own. Only You, O Amma, is our own. Protect us with kindness, you are the Mother of us all. 1. Mind is filled with darkness. Throw light and make it bright, O Amma. Take us by our hand and lead us on. Without you only barrenness. 2. We are sorrow stricken in our lives. We have wandered seeking love. Grant us devotion and bless us, O Amma. If not you, who else is our refuge?

The holy feet, whose beauty is beyond measure, are kissed by Mother Earth; those sweet feet that capture the minds of devotees, are enshrined in our hearts. 3. The sacred feet are the nest for devotion and liberation, they are wish-fulfilling tree to the destitute. With unwavering faith, let us worship this mother's feet, that are enshrined in our hearts.

NanEnnaSeyyavendum.footer: 1,2,3 4 Chorus: What should I do, Mother, to become your good son? You have thousands of excellent children; how will I also become good? 1. You are the ocean of nectar, Mother, you are the real form of bliss. Tell me my darling Mother, who else do I have to call my own? 2. O Mother, who sines everywhere, who never leaves my side. O Mother, overflowing with love, the whole world rests in your lap.

Niramilla.footer: B: It is told that the chataka bird will drink only raindrops as they fall during the rains. It does not relish any other water. The idea is that both the peacock and the chataka feel happy at the sight of clouds but become miserable in the absence of the rain. Likewise, waiting for God alone to make us happy seems to be in vain after prolonged search and spiritual practice not yielding its fruit.

NoOneIsYourOwn.title: No One Is Your Own
NoOneIsYourOwn.lyrics: O mind, be comesurrendered, al-low on-ly truthto be your friend. No-bod-y be longs just to you, no one is your own. Roundandround this worldyouwander, notseeing the reason why you're here. By do-ing such mean-ing-less act-ions, you can-not es cape. Asyou lis-ten to theprais-es ofthose who ad mire you do, re-mem-ber life pass-es quick-ly likeleaveson a stream. Af-ter be-ing cel e-brat-ed, this bod-y that car-riesyou from birth will be an a ban-doned dwell-ing, for-sak-en by life. Onand on you strugglebravely, ful-fill-ing desires ofthose you love,you sac-ri fice eve-ry-thing for them, in-clud-ing your life. E-ven those who loveyoudear-ly can-not stay besideyouafter death,your body they foundso at-trac-tive nowscaresthem a way. Captured in the snareof ma-ya, you're traveling a roadthathas no end. Re-mem-ber the Di-vine Moth-er, re-peat-ing Her Name. Leaving be-hind de-sir-es, join in the e ter-nalDance of Bliss, by sing-ing to Moth-er Ka-li, Ka li Ma ta. No-bod-y be longs just to you, no one is your own.

If one has the strong conviction that devotion is identical with one's own True Nature, then there is no harm in practising devotion while established in Knowledge. 31. When the state of real devotion is attained apprehending its basic principles, the devotee, without worshipping anything else, devotedly worships Devotion for the attainment of Liberation.

The present is in our control; whatever is to be gained, we should gain right now. 6. The mind that is the butterfly of desire is lured by the honey of enjoyments, losing its sight and its sense, comes to its end as the flower of the senses closes its petals around it.

OmkaraDivyaPorule10c.footer: flower to be worshipped. Each country is a petal in it. For Mother, no petal is different from any other. Each is to be loved. 8. Remember that "equal freedom for all", is the message of the ancient sages. Let us proclaim aloud the mantra of unity of all mankind. 9. Only when we know ourselves in depth we will get the experience of truth that the ancient sages visualized, and enjoy human freedom.

OmkaraDivyaPorule10d.footer: worlds. When the merit is exhausted, he returns to take a human body, as the lamp that goes out when there is no more oil. 8. Children, lead humble lives. Let not courage fade from the hearts. Point the arrow of sraddha (faith) at the promised goal of human life. 9. All the Vedas celebrate the single syllable Om. Brighten your heat with this sacred kernel of sound which is the symbol of the Self.

Remember that death is always walking behind, at touching distance. From time to time it will wake us up and remind us of its presence. 6. Children, cultivate devotion, faith and wisdom within; and shine like pearls becoming the essence of the statement, "Thou art That".

Children, embrace truth with no conditions; make your heart shine with that gentle spirit and let it open up like a full golden lotus blossom. 6. Yearn to be a little baby in the hands of the Divine Mother! Make every chapter of your life an ideal mirror for others!

Struggling in the fire of tension, don’t shed tears my children. Lift yourself up with courage as Mother is there to feed you with love. 8. In a pure eye, the whole world appears rich with consciousness. When the thoughts die away, the mirage of names and forms will vanish.

Adoring the caste system, people set fire to their own houses. The culture of Bharat (India) is burning in greed and self-interest. 10. People talk about idealism, but do not practice even a bit of it. If life is not established in practicing those ideals, talking about idealism is useless.

OmkaraDivyaPorule11c.title: Ômkâra Divya Poruöe 11c
OmkaraDivyaPorule11c.lyrics: Ôm kâ ra div ya po ru öe, va rû ô ma na mak ka öe vê gam Sam vâ da sa tran gaö vêñ øa, chî rum vag va da sîlk kâ ram veñ øa bhâ vat ma kan gaö â mâ dar åha åhud dhi yil ât ma vîr yam tra sik kyaø øe! If you work seeing the mirror of the mind, you can yield pure merit. 10. Merit acquired by worshipping women has been thrown into the fire of hell. The wildfire of their fall of virtue is burning and their crying can be heard all over the country.

OmkaraDivyaPorule11d.footer: s country never longed for compensation, as its duty was only wishing for peace to all. 12. We have forgotten everything and are living for sensual gratification. Whatever we see, has become a bad omen and can be called the misfortune of time. 13. Let your life be an offering to God placed on the leaf of your mind. Children, you who are the embodiment of the Self, try to kindle that spark of fire.

Children, learn to observe the thoughts that rise in your mind. Dispeling them, purify the mind with thoughts of the Self. 6. If you fight the battle of life bravely after understanding Mother’s teachings, you can reach the Great Goal destined for all souls. Coda: repeat as desired.

It is a truth that all the children who reach Mother have had their relationship with Her from the previous birth as well. 10. When the mind is purified like butter (ghee), what is real will reflect as It is within. When the Self, now under the spell of the mind, is awakened, the entire universe becomes the beautiful form of the Self.

vê ñam ba lam kæha-mâ åhî lam

One should have faith, humility, a disciplined mind, compassion, selflessness, strength and patience. 25. All the different religions lead us to the same Principle. It is like a painter using different colors to paint a picture.

OmkaraDivyaPorule6a.title: Ômkâra Divya Poruöê 6a
OmkaraDivyaPorule6a.lyrics: Ôm kâ ra div ya po ru öê va rû ô ma na mak ka öê vê gam Ô ma na yâi va öar nâ ma yan gaö nîk ki ôm kâ ra vas tu âi tî rû ôm kâ ra vas tu âi tî rû Snê-hat-tâl lôkam ja yik kyû mak-kaö jñâ-nâëkku tê-jas su tiëkkû dhyâ-nônmukham,bhak-ti bhâ vôj jwa lam, snê ha sândram hë dantam pu laëttû! Dê-åhasam skâram ve din-nyâl pin-ne åhêæhip pa ten tâ ñu nammiö Lô kat ti nîdut ta san-dê åha mê ku-vân î mañ-ñi nuñ-din nu num. Â rô dum uö öin tei uö öil mak-kaö snê-hâ da ran gaö pu laëttû â re yum uööa-ëin nyâ da-ri kyun-na-var â da-ra vaëhik-kyum mannil Lô-ka sa mâdhâ na daut-yam jan-ma sâphal yam en nôët tu ña rû. Vyak ti vai ran ga-öum, swâët-thaïmô han-gaöum chit tadauëbbal ya mâ ñôëkkû Ô öa-mat tâçha ka dal pôl ma-nam, ê-kânta åhân ta mâi tî rân jî vi-tâ åhlê æhi-kaö â kun-na chin ta-kaö êkî karik-kyu-ken makkaö. Dâ-sôha bhâ-vam pu laët tû mak-kaö swasthyam ma nas-sin nu ñaëttu; vâkkil ra sam vê-ñam, vê-ñam da yâr dra-ta vêñam swadhaëm-mâ va bôdham. Kai-valya dhâmam te öik-kyâm am-ma kai pi-di chen-num na yikkyâm kaita-vam vêñda sa mâ-dhâ na chit ta-râi cheyyu kaët-tav ya kaëmmam. Vyak-tiswâtan tëi-yat-te mak-kaö ve-ëum tu-cha kâr yâët tha-mâk kâ te maët-tya lô kattin vi muk ti kyu dât-ta-mâm kë-tyanga öâl dhanya mâkkû. Vid-vê æha bud dhi-yil mak kaö swa-yam niæh pa-ti chî dâ ti rikkû tyâga san naddha-râi, swâët tha vi hî na-râi jîvi-tâ nan dam pa karû. Un na-ta yâ thâët-dhya bô dham uö-öil un-ni-dra mâ-kaø øe yennum; uööat til nanma-yum un na tâ daë-åha-vum uööa-vaëk kil lal-lal engum. Tul-lya-râ ñammaik kyu mak kaö en-nâl tel-lum sa hik kil la dhaëmmam këæh-ñan sa hichil la, râ-man sa hi-chilla ârum sa hikkil la dhaëmmam. Jâ ti-yil nî cha-ral lâ rum nî-cha kaëm-mat tâl nî cha râ kunnu; ât ma samskâram te öin-nyôësa vaëñ-ña-râñ allêl a vaëñña-râ ñârum. Â-åhra-yik kyunna-vaë kî åhan hët-til swâåhra-ya bô-dham te öikkyum â åhri ta val sa-lan, âët ti vi nâ åhanan klêåhakaëmman-gaö ha nikkyum. Cheyyun na kaëmmat ti not t¨u pha-lam koy-yêñda vaë nam-maö ellâm; chey-yâte cheyyunna kaëm-man gaö tan phalam koyyâte koy-yêñ-da tum nâm. Kâ-makaëm man gaötya jik kyû mak-kaö jñâna kaëm môl su ka râkû. Vêda åhâs trattin ve öi-chet tâl sam-sâ ra åhôkandha kâ-ram a kattû. Mun-nil vi öik-kyun nu daivam mâ-ya pin-nil ta öak-kyun nu namme mâ-yâ ma yâëñ ña-vam nîn tik-ka dak ku-vân mâya-ñam dê hât ma bhâvam. Vi-bhra-mip pik-kyun nu mâ ya swan-tam viåh wa ra cha na yi lû de sat ya mal len ki-lum sat-ya-mâi tôn-nik-kyum raj ju-vil saëp-pam ka ñakke. Mâ-yai ka rutât tatilla mak-kaö mâ-yâ vi pat til pe dolle mâya ka dhîna-râi mâçh-kâ the mâ na-sam môha-vi muk ta-mâk kîdû. Sam-sâ-ra bî jam na åhi châl swa-yam san-tâ pa nâ-åham bha vikkyum an ta-rangattin na gâ dha ta yil mu-öa kûmbum a han-ta-yâm bîjam Pau-ru-æham nêdinâm nam me div-ya bhâvat ti lêi kyu yaë tê ñam vyak-ti sa twam pa-ri pûëñ ña-mâi dai-vat til aëp pi chu pûëñ-ñarâ kêñam.

OmkaraDivyaPorule6a.footer: t become victims of illusion and lament; free your mind from its clutches. 19. When the seed of samsara (the cycle of birth and death), the seed of egotism that sprouts in the deepest depth of the mind, is dead, then sorrows end of themselves. 20. Having attained human form, we should elevate ourselves to the Divine. We should surrender our individual selves totally to God and thus become perfect.

Faulty vision will bring fault to the Creation. If the eyes become dim, so will the Creation. 30. Children, one should have the power of expression and have compassion. One should acquire knowledge of diverse subjects and a deep perception of the universe.

OmkaraDivyaPorule6c.title: Ômkâra Divya Poruöê 6c
OmkaraDivyaPorule6c.lyrics: Ôm kâ ra div ya po ru öê va rû ô ma na mak ka öê vê gam Man-tra swa rû pam ma nas sil sa-dâ man-gâ te vaët tik ku kîl man-dî bha vik killa mâ nasam san-tâpa chinta-kaö mânnyas-ta mikkyum. Mê-ghat-tâl mû dun na sûr yan vîñ-dum åhô-bhichu min-nun na pô le aj-nyâna ghô ran dha kâ-ram po li yu-kil hëit til vi öan gum swa rûpam Pin-nôøøu pôkil la kâ lam mak-kaö mun-nôøøa di ve chu pô kû van-kâ rya sâddhyatte mûn-niët ti jî vi-tam munnôøøu sûkæhmam na yikkyû. Dâ-na-van vâna-va nâkâm vîñ-dum vâna-van dâ na va nâ kâm; vâ na-va, dâ na-va, mâ na-va sam-skâ ram mâna-va hët til-uñ dôëkkû. Tattwâëttha bud-dhi-yil mak kaö sa-dâ niswâëttha jî vi-tam nê dû. Vyak-ti bô dhattin na han tayat tûö ka-öam aëp pik ka dai-vat til makkaö. Alas, the body will decompose into its consituents one day. Know that there is no power that can suppress the power of a one-pointed mind.

They dedicate their life to the betterment of others, a succession of moments filled with concern for others. 21. Our life was not meant to be spent merely eking out a humdrum existence. Having had innumerable life-times behind us, it is essential to wake up now and know the purpose and deep significance of this incarnation.

OmkaraDivyaPorule8c.title: Ômkâra Divya Poruöê 8c
OmkaraDivyaPorule8c.lyrics: Ôm kâ ra div ya po ru öê va rû ô ma na mak ka öê vê gam Mâ-yak kya dhî-åhan ma hê-åhan ma hâ mayak kya dhî nan ma nu æhyan mô ha pâ åham koñ du mâ ya ban dhik-kun-nu åhô ka sam sâ rat-til nam-mê åhô ka sam sâ rat til nam mê. Âë-æha sid dhân-tan ga öel lâm maët tya jî vi-tâ åhlê æhi ka öal lo; jî va na dhaëm-ma-vum mô cha na maëm-ma-vum mê öi pa tâm saëg ga kâv-yam mê öi pa tâm saëg ga kâv yam. Vyak-ti vai ran-geö ve din-nyâl hët til sud-dha chai tan yam vi öan gum mut tit ta çhak-kyâ ta sû ya-yum spaëd-dha-yum sa chil pra kâ-åham te öik-ku sa chil pra kâ åham te öik ku. Mâ mu ni sat ta man mâ ril nin num â-va hich ad dhyât ma dî pam â yi rat tâñ dukaö kai pa-kaën nât-mâ-vil â öij jwa lik ka-yâ ñin-num â öij jwa lik ka yâ ñin num. E ëi yâl nut-tâñ du kâ lam dê hi dê ha nî èat-til va sik kâm nî dam ve din nyak ki öi pa ëak kum mum-be tê di-yâl ârk kum pi dik-kâm tê di yâl ârk kum pi dik kâm. Uñ-du-ëan gâ-nal la jan mam lak-æhyam san-tâ na sau-bhâg ya mal la bhô ga sam bat-tum pra åha sti yu môëk-ku-kil yô-ga sam-bat tâ-ñu mu khyam yô ga sam bat tâ ñu mu khyam. Nyâ-val pa çhamtin nu tin nu nâ vu nî li cha pôl maët tya chit-tam åhi li cha tâm bhô ga lâ la sa chin ta-yâl klâ vi chu tan ni ëam keø-øu klâ vi chu tan ni ëam keø øu. Vai-di-ka chin-tâ ta ran-gam viåh wamgum pa ran no çhu kaø-øe, maët tyan ma hê åha-nâi mâ ëum vi mô cha-na åhak ti man tram ja-yik kaø-øe åhak ti man tram ja yik kaø øe! Kâ-ñân ko tik-kun na tat-twam nê-ril kañ-dâ lum kâ ñât ta ten dê? Tan ne swa yam kâ ñum kañ ñin de kâçh-cha-yil an ya-num tâ nu mon nâ-kum an ya num tâ nu mon nâ kum. Dû-rat tu tê-dun na dai-vam tan de châ rat ti tâ va sik kun nu; maët tya rû pat til, da yâë ha bhâ vat-til nin aë cha nam kâmk-æhi chu nil-pu aë cha nam kâmk æhi chu nil pu. Tân gum ta ña lum il lâ-te ko dum yâ ta-na tin num ja natte pâ dê ma ëak kum na râ-dha man mâ ra-rum pâ pi-kaö en-nôëk ka mak-kaö pâ pi kaö en nôëk ka mak kaö. Kâ na-na chô la-kaö pô-le bha va sân dra gâ nâ më tam pô le ji vi ta man yaëk u ñaëv vin a nu-syu-ta kâ ha öa mâ-kaø øe yen-gum kâ ha öa mâ kaø øe yen gum. Sam-sâ ra vri-æhat ta lap pil pût tu kâk-kyun na tên ka ni yuñ-ñum, maët tya sa mu-ham su kha duï kha sam-miåh-ram e-tra-yô jan-man-gal eñ-num e tra yô jan man gaö eñ num! Na-vin de swâ-dôët tu pâ yum ma-nam nê-rin de swâ da ëi vî la ât ma ra sat tin te swâ da ëin nyâl pin-ne â ëu ra san ga-öum kaik-kum â ëu ra san ga öum kaik kum. Yâ-gâg ni keø øu pôi, pak-æhê hô ma dhu mam va mik kûn nu chuñ-dil sô ma ra sam pôi ma ran nyu ma dhyâ sak ti sô ma la ha riyâi mâ ri sô ma la ha ri yâi mâ ri. Uö-öinn u la-yil jwa lik-kum dai va san-kal pa åhak ti tan tîy yil pan kan ga öel-lâ ma kannaëk ka åhô-bha-vâi chuö-öam pa ram-vyôma mâ-kum chuö öam pa ram vyô ma mâ kum. Vai-di-ka man-tra dhwa ni yil mun gi kâ tum ka ra öum ku öiët tu, kâ la dê åhan gaö ka dan net tum ât-ma san dê åhat til mun-gaø-øe viåh-wan dê åhat til mun gaø øe viåh wan. Åhî-lak kê dê-rum åhi åhuk-kaö swan-tam mâ tâ vin chêlat ta lap-pil kai vi dâ tep po-çhum nyan nû kê çhun na pôl tê du-vin dai-vat-te mak-kaö tê du vin dai vat te mak kaö.

OmkaraDivyaPorule8c.footer: be consumed, and the all-embracing spiritual radiance will be like an unbounded supreme expanse. 40. Let the ears and heart exult in the sounds of vedic chanting; let the whole world be flooded with that joyous message, the differences in cultures and times notwithstanding. 41. Children, seek God like babies who hang onto their mothers' aprons, never letting go, and constantly plead for attention.

OmkaraMengum.title: Ômkâra Mengum
OmkaraMengum.lyrics: Ôm kâ ragum mu çhañ gi dun nû ô rô a ñu vi lum mât to li yâi Ô tu ka chit tam a dak ki nan nâi ôm åhak ti ôm åhak ti ôm åhak ti ôm Va-lu tâ yi kâ ñum pra pañcha mel lâm vi ra vil vë thâ yen nâ ëin nyi dum bôö Va ra vâ yi nin ne a ëi yu vâ nâi va ra dê va tê viåh wa van da nî yê A-ña poø øi yo-çhu-kan nu åhô ka bâæh pam tu ña yam ba mâ tra mâi tîën ni tip pôö Vëa ña tu cha bhô gam tya ji chi va ne a ñi ka ra mê ki a nu gra hik kyû Ke ñi va cha lau ki kâ åhak ti yel lâm pa ña mô ha jwâ la yil keø øa dan gum Tëa ña val ka rik kyun nu yô gi vën dam kæha ña nê-ra sukha mê kum më ga jî vi tam Bha va kâ-na nâg ni bha yan nu van nu bha ya bhañ ji nî nin pa da ma ñan nyu Bha va tâ ri ñî nî ve din nyu ven nâl bhu va nat til en ti nâi vâ ñi dê ñam Mëi ti bha-yagô ma ëan nyu pô yi mëiñ ma-ya kân ti yil â åha-yum pôi Sma ra ha-ra kân ti ka laën na nin mei sma ra ñam ni ran ta ra mâi va rê ñam Uö öil ni ëan nyu ka vin nya dîp ti mun nil te öi yun na nâö va rum bôö Un mat ta bhak ti yâl nin rû pa kân ti yil on nâ yi chêën nu la yik kyu mal lô A öa vat-tu kâ-ñân ko ti cha rû pam a ça kel lâm on nâ yu ran nyu kû di A tu li-ta saun dar ya mâi va run nû a la tal lu nnâ nan da bâæh pa dhâ ra Ôm åhak ti ôm åhak ti ôm åhak ti ôm

OmkaraMengum.footer: Incessant must come the remembrance of Thy Form which shines with the Light of °iva. 6. When the overflowing inner light fills within and overflowing without, shines before me, I will merge in the beauty of Thy Form through the intoxication of devotion. 7. This Form is what I longed to see most. All loveliness has crystallized and come as this unequalled beauty. And now the tears are overflowing.

OmkaraSvararupini.footer: chorus 2x, A(2x) Chorus: Aware O form of the Cosmic sound as a sweet mantra in my heart resonating to the chords of celestial vina in my soul. 1. Like the gracefully dancing peacock in the grove of contented ecstacy, dance the dance of bliss in the prepared venue of my life. 2. Thy Lotus Feet, thickly enveloped in the Light of the Supreme Self, grant auspiciousness through the destruction of the bondage of Becoming. Your real nature is divine bliss! Release me from the body-mind complex, O Goddess - light the lamp of knowledge, You whose form is consciousness absolute. To me, Thou art this world and the world beyond. Thou art my Guru and Mother. 3. Thou art the Giver of Eternal Bliss. Thou art That which is worshipped eternally, and Thou art the Goal of Life and the means to reach it, and Thou art the Light of Knowledge as well.

Radha, who is dying with only You in her thoughts, wants nothing else, Kanna! To A(1x), chorus 1x

RadhesyamRadhesyam.footer: knows no rest! 1. Everyone laughs at Mira and calls her a mad-woman. They tell her that she has fallen into a stone-hearted one’s trap. They all know the truth, yet act as though they know nothing, O Radheshyam! 2. Without Shyam, my mind feels lonely even in the crowd. Now I do not like the crowd of this world anymore. With whom can I share the pain of my heart? No one understands, O Radheshyam...

O Raghava, who rides on the bird (Garuda), O dark-blue One, bestower of bliss, save me, O destroyer of the sorrow of Thy devotees, bless me with the nectar of compassion.

I want to utilize my sorrows as opportunities to grow closer to You. 3. I want to kindle the awareness within that no support in this world is permanent. O Madhava, I, Your son immersed in the sea of samsara (worldiness), am crying. Bestow on me the boon to remove the tormenting afflictions of body consciousness. 3. Having been born as a human being, death is certain for me. By giving me pure devotion, O Lord of Lakshmi, save me from the clutches of death.

Carrying the trident, shining with radiance, beautiful and covered with ashes, You are the Supreme God and look beautiful dancing and making music on Your drum. You are adored by Parvati and ever-auspicious.

For those deluded ones who wallow in the dense darkness, meditation on Thy Name and Form is the only solution for their wretched state. 3. Cast a glance with Thy beautiful glowing eyes on my mind. O Mother, Thy Grace is the only means for reaching Thy Lotus Feet.

To them should be given the gratitude of humanity. Speech, subdued by a feeling of awe, cannot describe the great power that animates this creation.

O Mother, who resides in the heart, who destroys my sorrows, who is the embodiment of knowledge and Truth, who is the witness to the passing of night and day. 2. O Mother, who is the peacock dancing in our hearts, who is praised by the Vedas and Agamas, who sustains the Earth. Book III, p 204 WTR 1995/2 Sanskrit
