Let me reflect on Thy Holy Name until the moment of my death. 2. Thou art the Bestower of boons in this dark age of materialism. Thou art the very life and the vital energy within me. With compassion, kindly give this helpless one refuge at Thy Lotus Feet forever.

I believe that You will protect me like eyelids protecting the eyes, guard me without even blinking your eyes, and open my eyes to the Truth and therefore I take refuge at Your feet, O Devi.

When I bow down to that radiant bliss of Your presence, the feeling of 'me' disappears. Then the understanding dawns on me that birth, karma, the manifested world and the unmanifested Reality are all just so many aspects of my Mother.

You ride on the mouse, you are the lover of modaka sweets, son of Shiva and Parvati. You are the teacher and the source of auspiciousness. Faster: To chorus as desired.

You are as a sister to Vishnu, immortal Goddess, in the form of the mantra "Hrim", the ruler of all, the Lord of the king of kings.

Devotion alone is enough to attain enlightenment.

As a poisonous snake coils and bites, the most bitter pain in this heart has spread darkness around me. Disperse this sorrow, shower nectar in my heart. Let wisdom dawn in me like the rising sun!

All that manifests emerges from it, and dissolves again into the unmanifest. 4. True knowledge is immortality, bliss and eternity. All that exists in the world is not separate from you. That is your eternal nature. Fix your mind on this truth.

He razed Lanka with his tail. He defied the lord of Lanka (Ravana). Hanuman, son of Anjana, is lord Rama’s devotee. 2. He brought back the Sanjivani mountain. He earned the name of Ciranjivi (immortal). Hanuman, son of Anjana, is lord Rama’s devotee.

Tulasidasa is thus glorifying his Lord Ramachandra who is supreme joy to Lord Shiva and to all the sages. Tulasidasa prays to his beloved Lord to constantly abide in the lotus heart of His devotee so that all the worldly desires and other blemishes can be destroyed completely.

God and humankind can never exist as separate entities. 2. So many instruments yet only one electric current. So many deities yet only one God. There is unity in this apparent diversity. One becomes many - this is how creation unfolds itself.

Such a mind will be forced to toss around in misery like a leaf tossed by the waves of the restless ocean. 2. Do not get caught in the talons of the vulture known as fate. Worship the Self in seclusion. Stop searching for results everywhere and worship the form of the Universal Self in the blossom of the heart!

O butter thief, You have stolen the hearts of everyone! 2. When I first saw You, I could not take my gaze away. I was immersed in an ocean of bliss. 3. O Shyam, You dwell in my heart, only Your name is on my lips. I cannot perceive anything other than You, O dark complexioned One.

O lotus-eyed Venugopala, Who embodies the Truth of the Vedas, Lover of music, and the Lord of Gokula - the gopis adore You and You love the divine sport of Rasa. 2. O lotus-eyed Kanna, Compassionate one, Destroyer of sorrow, Slayer of Kamsa, Your sport is enchanting and Your very Name annihilates my suffering.

O Mother, please remain as the spring of my inspiration. 2. Being both of one and of many forms, Thou art the Light of the Absolute. Knowest Thou not my heart well? Won’t Thou come before me even though I ask?

I am not even able to utter Your name; when I do so I am left drenched with tears.

How shall I search for You? How shall I see You? O Mother listen to me! 2. This child of Yours is just a toddler. How can he live alone, without his Mother? Who will take care of him? Who will nourish him with love? O Mother, listen to me!

Your wondrous good deeds even for the undeserving turn my mind to thoughts of serving the world, making me eternally selfless. You are the very embodiment of goodness.

SyamSyamKukadiMe.footer: Shyam I have come more and more to resemble Him. For His sake my own reputation has suffered. 1. O Shyam, please come before me at least once or I will give up my life. Do not deceive my heart. This world has become amazed seeing my condition. 2. Shyam, what magic resides in Your flute! Even the heart of innocent Radha becomes shy. I have given up everything to hear the sound of that flute, Shyam!

TakeMeDeepInYourEyes.lyrics: Ev-ery-where You go, I will be there with You. No mat ter if it looks like I am here. I have placed my heart like a flow er at Your feet. This night of sor-row ends when You are near. Take me deep in Your eyes, far a way from my life, to the place where we be-come noth ing-ness. Take me deep in Your eyes, far a way from my mind, to the place where we merge with ev-ery-thing. Take me through-out my life I have cherished just one dream, the dream of know ing love that is di vine. When Your mag ic smile reach-ed deep in to my soul, the ten-der lamp of hope be-gan to shine. Take me Man-y tears have fall en on the ground where you have stood. I'm drift ing in a sea of mem or ies. Faith is my sole friend as I wait for Your re turn, and lis-ten for Your voice in ev-ery breeze. Take me Some pray for sal va tion, some pray to be healed. Some will pray to re a lize the truth. Ev ery night and day, like a song that has no end, I pray that I may al-ways be with You. Take me

Thou art the very soul of Realization and the sole refuge. 5. Devi, give me power to speak on the essential ideas. Rid yourself of both merit and sin; they are responsible for the cycle of birth and death. 2. Thoughts in the mind are like dirt covering up the Lord inside the heart. O Mother, whose form is truth and joy, there is no other refuge for me than Your compassion which You eternally shower in my heart. You are the source of all happiness, of noble heart and of graceful form.

My karma will melt away in that worship. 2. When all my sins are absolved, inner peace will come to me of its own accord. That bliss alone will give immortality. To attain immortality, I worship Your honored lotus feet and take refuge in You.

Everyday I waited for you with a garland, but by evening when you had not come, the flowers had drooped along with my face. When you came today, I had not made a garland, so I am garlanding you with heart-felt songs of your praises.

UnnumSorum.footer: l music sung by the tongue, who has given us these? The Mother Goddess seated on a lotus, the eternally blissful Mother, She has given these. 2. The sunrise and the shining moon which illuminate the sky, the riches of harvest which are nourished by the rain, who has given us these? The Mother holding the sword and the trident in Her hands, the Eternally Blissful One, She has given us all of these.

UsakalaNeram.lyrics: U æhaïkâ la nê ram tu æhâ kan ni åhâ gan dhi yô chô dik ka yâi Khê dip pa ten tu nî åhô bha pra sû na mê Châ rat tin nil la yô nin ja na nî hâ rat tin nil la yô nin ja na nî? UsakalaNeram.footer: I also did austerities for gaining love during sorrow-filled days with a heavy heart. Mother ignored me. Seeing my miserable condition, the darkened clouds shed many tears. 2. Being thirsty, I drank all the streams of tears and gained some peace. I didn't become a coward. With bravery, even today, I look for that ocean of love. 3. If Mother won't come with love to help us, let us cry till the end.

UttamaPremattin.footer: e. O Pure One who gives pure affection, I worship Thy Feet with my tears. 1. Hearing the nectarean, joy-giving words of the Embodiment of Truth who abides beyond where thought can reach; my heart, eyes and ears have become tranquil and quiet.’ 2. That love can be described by none. It is beyond words. Then how can I hope to speak about it? I can only bow down again and again with tears in my eyes.

UyirayiOliyayi.footer: all defects are increasing in the absence of Thee who art the Real Knowledge concealed. 2. Thou art protecting this pitiful city (the body) stinking with blood, bone and flesh. We clean the surface of the body alone knowing not its Lord. 3. The monkey of the mind wanders ceaselessly, holding in its hand the fruit of conceit. Reflecting not on its Real Nature, it becomes food for the God of Death.

Vadikorinetra.footer: gan hearing continuous music, the tongue tasted sweet ambrosia, there arose a sweet aroma, for the sense of touch there was a warm, loving embrace. Satguru shines as a brilliant form, destroying all darkness of illusion. 4. My Satguru is beyond the reach of the five senses. His words can reach there. My Satguru is the giver of the five-syllabled mantra which stands as bright as thousands of moons.

Annihilator of the demon Sumba, enchantor of Lord Shiva, who dispels the fear in worldly existence, grant me the nectar of Your compassion. 5. The remembrance of You brings auspiciousness, O Mother of the universe. I salute Your blessed feet, O mother of the entire Earth.

The universal drama is being enacted on the stage of my heart which is the platform for Thee to dance. Come with the dancing steps, humming a tune, Thou, Who art ever desirous of offering benevolent boons.

VandanaKaruMe.footer: ge. 1. Your divine name has so much power. The repetition of it bestows one with devotion. O lord, I request You never to let my mind wander and to let it be filled with thoughts of You. 2. Though You are omnicient my lord, I have the earnest desire to see You. So please appear before me in Your adorable form. Be enshrined in my heart forever; that alone will destroy all of the darkness within me.

Is it right to abandon one’s dharma and then blame God for the consequences? While living, we have many relatives. After death, who is there to call our own? The mind is a temple. Kali is enshrined therein. Remembering this always, let us awaken god-consciousness.

I salute that One who moves about Vrindavan, the Son of Nanda, Delighter of Radha! 4. Salutations to the Protector of the sages, of enchanting form, Lover of the flute, beautiful cowherd Boy who stays on the banks of the Yamuna and moves about Vrindavan!

Please, constantly abide in my mind - dwell always in my mind as sweet thoughts, and dwell in my words like the sweetness of honey. 3. Let there not be any evil thoughts in my mind. Fill my heart with righteous thoughts. Protect me from all dangers. O Mother, bestow upon me a cheerful and solicitous attitude.

O Thou Atom of atoms, Who pervades the Universe, Dweller in the Thousand-petalled Lotus, come, come. 5. Whose brilliance equals millions of suns, Dweller within myself, that Mother alone is the only hope for getting merged in Her. 6. O Ambrosial Light, Ocean of Bliss, may my mind merge in Thee forever.

Assuming a form merely as a play, renowned for dispelling delusion, who is tenderly merciful toward the destitute, I prostrate to You, Ruler of All! 5. O Mother! who has no beginning or end, who is blissfully charming, who revels in solitude, I prostrate to Thee, Sustainer of the Universe!

When will that day dawn when my mind and soul will become pure? Then vain pride, possessiveness, bashfulness and affliction will be relinquished. 3. Grant me a boon, grant me a heart that can accept others as my own and that I can carry out selfless actions.

Whoever calls out to You, O Mother, he soon finds that all of his problems in life are leaving him. O Mother, whoever comes before Your divine presence, You awaken eternal peace in his mind. 3. O Mother, there is none other equal to You, embodiment of love, embodiment of compassion. A hundred thousand prostrations at Your feet.

VarumoIniyum.title: Varumô Iniyum
VarumoIniyum.lyrics: Va ru mô i ni yum i tu va çhî o ru nâö i vi de yî vën dâ va na bhû mi yil yil En de ma nas sin de vën dâ vana vâ di yil! En de yil! A krû ra nen no ru pê rô ti van na yâö e tra yum nird da yan â yi run nil la yô? Ak ko dum krû ra tayk kin num pra tî ka mâi Kañ èi dâ mât mâ vil tê ru rûö châ lu kaö! Or else, what is the need in saying all this, I am not separate from Madhava inside. If you are the pallavi of flute, will I not be the anupallavi of it always? (Pallavi refers to the opening lines of a song, anupallavi to the verses that follow it.)

Yes, He has come here already - I think He has come. Did you see the brightness of His yellow attire? 3. I will welcome Him by self-surrender. (Surely He will bless me). When I bathe His divine feet with my tears, I am sure He will shower mercy on me.

O son of Shakti, five-handed one, son of Siva, You are the destroyer of all restlessness, You are the creator, the purest, do come to grant us victory. 2. All-pervading one, You who remove all the sorrows of the devotees, O Lord of auspiciousness, served by all of mankind, please grant us the boon of not forgetting Your lotus feet. He alone filled my heart, rooted as memories in my mind. 2. I stood longing like Radha, my mind engrossed fully in thoughts of him. I forgot myself in the melody of his flute. When he came near unexpectedly, I became transfixed.

You were born in this sacred land as Amrita Devi to counteract all the sinful deeds of people like us. 2. O Amma, won't You please look at us? We are ever waiting, yearning for Your sidelong glances. 3. We, Your ignorant children, have been following You. O Mother, please carve out a path for us to tread.

Mother is the cause of all things. 5. Deign to rid me of this terrible cycle of birth and death. Protect this miserable one. 6. Bowing to Thee with joined palms, I pray, give me Liberation. O Powerful One, Great Radiance, I bow to Thee.

Even though you might not come, Kanna, pleas grant me a hundred lives spent immersed in thoughts of you, searching for you. Grant me a thousand births that I may know you.

O Mother, O Bhagavati Devi, aren’t Thou knowing that without merging in Thy mind-enchanting Being, there is no peace?

Won’t Thou cast a sidelong glance to help me? 2. At the invitation of thankless fate, please do not send me again to Earth for the mundane feast. Kindly bless me, Mother, to remain with my mind incessantly adhering to Thy Feet.

We realize that our sense organs are blinded by the bewitching spell of maya (delusion). O Ganapati, we bow down to you. You are our savior.

O King of the world, we praise You. With your smiling face You will save the universe!

The captivating sound of Krishna's flute cools my heart. Without my knowing, my heart rapidly flows and dissolves in that bliss.

So anxious is she to hear the sound of Krishna's flute that the music of the festival has no attraction for her. 3. All her friends wonder - 'Why hasn't Radha come?' Radha says, 'Only when Krishna arrives, will spring arrive for me.'

Come as the principle of rhythm/sound to flow in my veins everyday. Come dancing, swaying and running! 3. O Tamer of Kaliya, lotus-eyed One, light the lamps. VyathaAriyikkan.footer: with compassion, that shall be my refuge. 1. Thy twin eyes radiate countless rays of auspiciousness, will not a tiny wave from among them caress my body, O Mother? 2. Bewildered, my mind is restless, the body is collapsing, but for Thy Grace, O Mother, I see nothing else for support. 3. Remember if you forsake me, my life shall be in vain, Mother. Am I not worthy to seek refuge at Thy Lotus Feet?

YamunaNadi.lyrics: Ya mu nâ na di tî ram kañ ñan vi çhi yô ram Râ dhâ a nu râ gam gô pi vai bhô gam Mau nam moçhi yâ kum ma na mum mayi lâ kum Kañ ñan kâr mê gham kâ ña ma yi lâ øum Vi çhi yum mo çhi sol lum vidhi yai a tu vel lum Kaöi yil ma nam tuö öum kât trin i dam aö öum Vê ñu i sai pâ øum vi nai kaö pa ran tô øum An bil ma nam kû øum a mai ti ta vaçhn tâ øum Kañ ñan mu khamkâ ña kân ti e nai îrk kum Sarv va mum a va nâ ka åhân ti ni lai yâ kum

YamunaNadi.footer: the mind becomes a peacock who sees the cloud-colored Krishna and dances. The eyes talk, bad karma is destroyed, the mind dances and one feels as if in a soft breeze. 2. Listening to the music from (Krishna's) flute all bad karma disappears, the mind merges in Love, a sublime peace reigns. I am pulled as if by a magnet to see Krishna's face and then I feel peace as if everything around is Krishna.

YamunaTiraVihara.footer: to Gopala! 2. O Krishna, Your heart is an ocean of compassion. Your story is praised by the great ones such as Sage Narada. Auspicious abode, Your eyes are like lotus petals. You are the one described in the Vedas. 3. O celestial being, the central charactor of the Gita, O son of Devaki, Your name gives protection. Grandson of King Surasena, You wear yellow garments, O pure feet, Mukunda, save me!
